goal: Generate a single 4×3 grid, featuring busts or half-bodies of twelve main deities, with English names and corresponding Chinese positions below each grid cell, formatted like art museum exhibition labels.

theme.mythology: Greek mythology of the Twelve Olympian gods

style.art_style: 17th-18th century European classical oil painting thick application, dark background highlighting figures
style.color_palette: Deep blue curtain + gold trim + warm brown skin tone + small amount of red robe

layout.background: Each grid has an independent dark brown or midnight blue halo, with a 1px gold line frame on all sides

panel_design.label_content: Downward: English name of the deity (capitalized) + short Chinese role, for example 'Zeus Sky and Thunder' 'Hera Marriage and Family'

user_list: Hera Goddess of marriage and family
Poseidon, the god of the sea and earthquakes
Demeter Goddess of agriculture and harvest
Athena, Goddess of Wisdom and War
Apollo, God of Light and Archery
Artemis, Goddess of Hunting and the Moon
Aphrodite, Goddess of Love and Beauty
Hephaestus God of fire and craftsmanship
Hermes God of messengers and travelers
Dionysus God of wine and festivity

constraints.must_feel: Museum display level uniform light source comes from the upper left, with a divine solemnity, no modern jokes
constraints.avoid: Mixing Roman god names, misplacing professions, styles and aesthetics resembling 12 different AI seeds
